adds.title: HB 1570 - Arkansas ban on puberty blockers, hormone therapy for under 18
adds.summary: On March 29, 2021 the Arkansas Senate passed HB 1570 (Arkansas SAFE Act) by 28-7 after House passage to prohibit provision or offer of gender-affirming care including puberty blockers, hormone therapy and surgery to persons under 18, to bar state funds and state-operated insurance coverage for such care and to risk providers' licenses for violations pending governor action within five days, while on March 25, 2021 Arkansas enacted a prohibition on trans girls and women participating as their gender in school sports from kindergarten through college and enacted the Medical Ethics and Diversity Act allowing doctors, nurses, EMTs and other healthcare workers to refuse care based on religious, moral or ethical beliefs.

adds.title: Arkansas transgender athlete ban - signed March 25, 2021
adds.summary: On March 25, 2021, Arkansas enacted a law prohibiting transgender women and girls from competing on school sports teams consistent with their gender identity across K-12 and collegiate sports, limiting women's sports to exclude students of the male sex and allowing a student or school claiming direct or indirect harm to sue a school for violation, with effect scheduled for summer 2021 absent a legal block.
